items.headline: Nvidia posts $115.8 billion quarterly revenue and reassures investors under interim CEO after Jensen Huang’s departure
items.summary: Interim chief Colette Kress led the earnings call, highlighting strong demand for AI chips despite the sudden resignation of founder Jensen Huang. The company’s results aim to calm shareholders while the board evaluates the founder’s possible return.

items.headline: AI startup Anthropic prepares for a $1.4 trillion‑valued IPO, positioning itself as a key player in the sector’s boom
items.summary: Founded just five years ago, Anthropic’s planned New York listing would make its founders billionaires and test whether investor enthusiasm for generative‑AI can sustain a market rally. Analysts say the offering could either shore up confidence or highlight the bubble’s limits.

items.headline: Former McDonald’s employee urges chain to overhaul treatment of young staff as court allows sex‑abuse case to proceed
items.summary: A judge ruled that a lawsuit alleging systematic sexual abuse of teenage workers can move forward, prompting a former crew member to call for policy changes at the fast‑food giant. The case raises broader questions about workplace safety and corporate responsibility in the service industry.
